prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane on a Sugar Land, Texas roadway when Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the adjacent lane, began to change lanes without a sufficient view of the vehicle beside them. The two vehicles made contact along their passenger-side and driver-side panels, and Driver 2's vehicle pushed Driver 1's vehicle toward the shoulder before both came to rest. Driver 1 and a Passenger were present in the vehicle at the time, and responding officers and independent witnesses at the scene confirmed their presence. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain shortly after the collision and was evaluated at the scene. The damage visible on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the side-impact described by the parties, and the injuries reported are consistent with the force of a lateral collision of this kind. Driver 2 acknowledged the lane change and did not dispute the sequence of events. Witness statements and photographs taken at the scene support the account given by both drivers. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the responding officers or reported by any party. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved. Based on the information gathered, the reporting officer has documented this incident as a sideswipe collision during a lane change.
